_comment: Scorecard 2 (user feel): fixed limits from published response-time and frame-rate standards, so a score does not depend on which other apps were measured. Weights must total 100 and need the lead's sign-off, like weights.json.

speed.label: Screens respond quickly
speed.rule: Each screen time (first open, re-open, detail, refresh, resume, tab switch): up to 0.4 s = 100, up to 1 s = 70, up to 10 s = 30, slower = 0. Averaged over the screens measured.
speed.source: Doherty threshold (0.4 s); Nielsen response-time limits (1 s, 10 s)

smooth.label: Scrolling looks smooth
smooth.rule: 60 fps or more while scrolling = 100, below = 30.
smooth.source: Android vitals: frames within 16 ms (60 fps) count as smooth

friction.label: No extra steps
friction.rule: Starts at 100; minus 50 if it asks for the PIN again after 30 s in the background; minus 50 if the screen has no pull-to-refresh.

battery.label: Battery lasts
battery.rule: Least battery used in 15 min on the screen = 100; others = least ÷ the app's use.

reliability.label: No hangs
reliability.rule: Starts at 100; minus 30 for each screen where one run took over 3× its median.
